cards.name: the-room
cards.headline: The bedroom is a planned talk, <mark>not a Monday</mark> morning one.
cards.body: Agree a ten minute reset at a time that is not the morning. They pick the time and the music. The door stays shut on the rest.

cards.name: sunday-homework
cards.headline: Sunday night is too late to <mark>teach planning.</mark>
cards.body: Tonight, help with the first step only. Then a ten minute chat on Friday where they map the weekend's work.

cards.name: after-school
cards.headline: Fine at school, explodes at home? They save it <mark>for you.</mark>
cards.body: You are the safe place. Snack first, quiet first, questions about the day later.

cards.name: first-phone-guide
cards.headline: When should my child get a phone?
cards.body: Not an age. A set of things they can already do. The free guide walks through them.

cards.name: stage-check
cards.headline: What stage is your child <mark>at?</mark>
cards.body: Three questions, no sign up. Then the next step for their age.
